subject.title: Rowland Unified School District Board, Area 5

text: Occupation: Physics Professor/Scientist

My name is Dr. Kevin T. Hayakawa. I'm a Cal State Physics Professor and NASA Principal Investigator. As a professor, I train the next generation of doctors, scientists, and engineers. I'm running for re-election to the Rowland Unified School District Board of Education this November. Serving on the school board over the past 4 years has been one of the greatest honors of my life. Rowland Unified isn't just the district I represent—it's the district that raised me. Here's my story:

Ybarra Academy, Telesis Academy, and Rowland High School,
- Bachelor's degrees in Physics and Astrophysics from UC Berkeley,
- Master's degree in Astronomy from UCLA,
- Ph.D. in Astronomy and Astrophysics from UCLA,
- 11+ years of teaching experience in all three segments of California's public higher education system: the University of California (UC), the California State University (CSU), and the California Community Colleges (CCC),
- 5+ years of local government experience at both the school district and water district,
- 25+ year resident of Rowland Heights.

My second-term platform centers around 5 themes:
1.

—Expand Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics education at every grade level.
2.

—Expand access to Advanced Placement (AP), International Baccalaureate (IB), Career Technical Education, and other pathways that prepare students for college, military service, skilled trades, and careers.
3.

—Recruit and retain outstanding teachers, classified professionals, and administrators through competitive compensation and benefits.
4.

—Maintain long-term financial stability while preparing for future emergencies and continuing to invest in students.
5.
—Continue engaging students, families, employees, and community members through accessible public meetings and outreach.

Community involvement:
- Buckboard Days Parade Planning Committee, Member
- Rowland Heights Community Coordinating Council, Member
- Walnut Valley Water District, Former Director
I would be honored to once again earn your support.
Vote Dr. Kevin T. Hayakawa for Rowland Unified School District Board of Education!

text: I'm Falynn Love Thompson, a Rowland Unified parent, business owner, and community member for over 20 years. I chose to raise my family in the community my husband grew up in, and I am a proud parent of a Rowland High School graduate and a daughter still navigating Rowland Unified. I'm running for the Rowland Unified School District Board of Education, Trustee Area 5, to build a comprehensive support system for our students. I will work to elevate RUSD's status as a competitive school district while ensuring students' academic, mental, and behavioral needs are met. I will advocate for competitive compensation, benefits, and growth opportunities for certificated and classified staff. I will nurture a partnership between the district and families rooted in two-way communication, accountability, and opportunities for families to be part of their students' education. I will work to make sure every school receives the same standard of care to promote positive learning environments. I will work to ensure district spending aligns with community priorities and has maximum positive impact. I'm not a career politician and have no political aspirations beyond serving our Rowland Unified community. I'm running to shape a RUSD we can all be proud of.
